# SheetJS CE

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS CE 0.20.3 package downloaded from
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz.

The archive is stored in the repository so `npm ci` does not depend on the
availability of the SheetJS CDN. This follows the upstream
[vendoring instructions](https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/#vendoring).
The package includes its Apache-2.0 license.
